$comment: Character customization rules (docs/CHARACTER_CUSTOMIZATION.md). unlockTags: append-only list of tags gameplay can grant (bit = index, max 64); wearables in assets cosmetics reference these strings in unlockTags. rules grant a tag on a gameplay event: on = firstJoin | craft (recipe key) | stallSale (seller side) | raidBreach (attacker breached a gate/door). wardrobeRange: tiles from a piece with features.wardrobe for re-editing after the first-join creator.
